artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan wiring a NO_CLASSIFY=1 module option into both sapience module trees and recording the measured per-pass cost in docs/sapience.md.

memory_candidates.content: This repo carries the Sapience home-manager module in two hand-maintained parallel trees: modules/home/services/sapience.nix (the live machine config) and packages/sapience-flake/ (a standalone, externally-consumed flake whose lib/wrappers.nix is shared by its own flake.nix packages output, its modules/sapience.nix, and its checks/default.nix). The established convention for a vendor env-var toggle is: the same option name in both trees, but DIFFERENT defaults -- the published flake matches the vendor default, the dotfiles module flips it with a machine-specific measured rationale in the option description (memoryFiles/NO_MEMFILES is the working precedent). Adding an argument to lib/wrappers.nix requires updating all three of its callers in one commit or evaluation fails, which makes such a change a genuine atomic-batch. Reaching inside ~/.sapience/*.py instead is the wrong lever class entirely: that payload self-updates daily and silently overwrites any patch.
